name: PumpDuck
description: Envelope-follower sidechain. Follows AUDIO IN (raw input when available) and ducks amplitude, a resonant filter, or an internal plate while the pad is held. X = attack/release feel, Y = depth. DEST selects the duck destination.

params.name: DPTH
params.detail: How far the destination is ducked

params.name: HPF
params.detail: High-pass the detector so it locks to kick
